snippet.title: Wizzo PopOut - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Jump onto a bouncing magic bubble and unleash some spell-casting chaos in Wizzo PopOut, a fast-paced 3D arena shooter for up to four players.

Choose your Wizzo and battle across dynamic arenas where momentum is everything. The more damage you take, the further you'll fly when hit — so master your movement, dodge incoming attacks and knock your rivals out of the arena before they do the same to you.

Pick up and combine two spells on the fly from more than 10 unique abilities to create your own loadout. Swap spells during battle to reset your cooldowns, chain together new combinations and adapt to the chaos around you.

Wishlist Wizzo PopOut now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670670/Wizzo_PopOut/

Coming to PC, Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.
